before_use_check_docs.rule: Before using ANY model for the first time, fetch its llms.txt to verify endpoint, parameters, prompt style, and limitations. Never assume a model works like another.
check_items: field name (image_url vs start_image_url vs image_urls)
models_that_lie_in_docs: fal-ai/flux-2-pro/edit — docs claim 9 ref images but multi-character tests failed 2/2 times. Test before trusting.

debug.description: Cheapest possible models for pipeline validation only (not for output quality)

testing.description: Good balance for fast iteration and testing with reasonable quality

budget.description: Good balance of quality and cost for production use. First-frame continuity via Kling O1 Standard.
budget.video_duration_notes: Only 5s or 10s accepted when using start_image_url

quality.description: Best character consistency and Pixar-quality output. Uses Kling v3 for multi-prompt/element control.
quality.video_duration_notes: Only 5s or 10s when using start_image_url. 3-10s without start_image_url.

omni.description: Reasoning-based video via Gemini Omni Flash. Audio is included. Terse natural-language briefs outperform verbose positional prompts. ~$0.13/s for video, audio replaces the separate xAI TTS step when narration is not needed.
omni.video_duration_notes: Default 8s. Duration is integer (NOT string). Audio is always generated; cannot be disabled.

safety_notes.nano-banana: safety_tolerance ranges 1 (strictest) to 6 (most permissive). We use 6. However, the internal Gemini safety guardrails can still block prompts involving: violence, injury, fear/panic of minors, abandonment, crying children. If blocked, rewrite prompt to use positive framing (e.g. 'looking around with wonder' instead of 'lost and scared').
safety_notes.gpt-image: No configurable safety parameter. OpenAI's internal content policy applies. Prompts involving minors in distress may be blocked. Use neutral/positive framing.
safety_notes.seedream: enable_safety_checker: false disables the external checker. Internal model guardrails may still apply.
safety_notes.seedance: No configurable safety parameter. Handles most story content without issues.
safety_notes.kling: No safety parameter exposed. Handles most story content without issues. The cfg_scale parameter (0.5) gives models more creative freedom vs strict prompt adherence.
safety_notes.grok: No configurable safety parameter. Internal xAI guardrails apply.
safety_notes.gemini_omni: Same risk class as nano-banana — Gemini-family internal guardrails apply. No safety_tolerance parameter is exposed in the schema. Prompts involving minors in distress, violence, or fear may be blocked. Use positive framing as a workaround. Geo-restriction: the edit endpoint (google/gemini-omni-flash/edit) is not available for uploaded videos in the EEA, Switzerland, and the UK. T2V / I2V / R2V generation is unrestricted.

ara.description: Warm, friendly — best for emotional stories, gentle narration

eve.description: Energetic, upbeat — best for exciting adventures, playful tales

sal.description: Smooth, balanced — best for neutral narration, calm stories

music.auto_prompt_template: instrumental {mood} {style}, {atmosphere}, no vocals, cinematic Pixar soundtrack style, acoustic

generation_log.description: Durable per-generation metadata for cost analysis and quality optimization. One JSON line per FAL API call. Written by scripts/log_gen.sh. Read by scripts/generation_report.sh and scripts/fal_cost_summary.sh.

schema.asset: character_image | scene_image | scene_video | background_image | narration_audio | music_audio

debug.description: Grok Imagine — variable duration, no frame continuity

budget.description: Kling O1 Standard — 5s or 10s, start_image_url for continuity

quality.first_frame_notes: Kling O1 start_image_url = style reference only. For strict frame-to-frame continuity, use Wan FLF2V (both start+end frames, fixed 5s, $0.40 flat).

cinematic.description: Seedance 2.0 Fast — 4-15s, first/last frame, native audio

omni.description: Gemini Omni Flash — integer duration, default 8s, audio always included, image_url treated as actual first frame. Treat as approximate until validated (no enum exposed in schema).

kling_2.5_turbo.pitfalls: Prompt field was missing in early calls — must pass motion-only prompt alongside image_url

wan_flf2v.pitfalls: Both start AND end frame images are mandatory — passing only one returns 'Field required' for end_image_url. Duration param is silently ignored — always produces 5s output. Best for short seamless transitions between two key frames.

kling_o1.pitfalls: start_image_url is a CHARACTER/STYLE REFERENCE, NOT a strict first frame. The generated video does NOT start from the exact input image — it uses it for identity cues. For true frame-to-frame continuity, use Wan FLF2V instead. Using image_url (not start_image_url) returns 'Field required'.

grok_imagine_video.pitfalls: Prompt is required even for image-to-video. Missing prompt returns 'Field required'. No start_image_url support.

seedance_2.0.pitfalls: Duration is string ('5' not 5). Missing prompt returns 'Field required'.

wan_flf2v.pitfalls: Both start AND end frame images are mandatory — passing only one returns 'Field required' for end_image_url.

xai_tts.pitfalls: Using 'input' field instead of 'text' returns 'Field required'. Always use 'text'.

nano_banana_2.safety: safety_tolerance must be string '6' not integer 6
nano_banana_2.pitfalls: Integer 6 is rejected. Use '6' (string). limit_generations: true recommended.

mp3_concat.pitfalls: FFmpeg concat demuxer with -c copy produces silent/corrupt MP3 files due to timestamp drift. Must use filter_complex concat with re-encode.

flux_prompt_length.pitfalls: FLUX models (Klein, Pro) expect short, single-sentence prompts (max 3 sentences). Long positional multi-subject prompts cause hallucination and character merging. Use @image1 syntax for multi-reference. Never use 200+ word prompts with FLUX.

gemini_omni.duration: integer (default 8, accept range — not yet enum-locked in schema)
gemini_omni.response: queue (async, requires polling) — assumed based on Google video family pattern; validate in Phase 3 smoke test
gemini_omni.edit_endpoint_geo_restriction: EEA, Switzerland, UK — edit on uploaded videos is blocked. T2V/I2V/R2V unrestricted.
gemini_omni.reference_to_video_schema_caveat: Endpoint description mentions audio and video inputs but schema only exposes image_urls. Treat as image+text only until verified.
gemini_omni.prompt_style: INVERSE of other video models. Reasoning-based: terse 1-3 sentence natural-language briefs outperform verbose 7-element positional prompts. Use 'omni-conversational' prompt style (see prompt_styles section).
gemini_omni.pitfalls: Do NOT pass verbose Kling-style 7-element prompts. The reasoning architecture is designed to NOT need them. Do NOT re-describe outfit/hair when using image reference — text overrides the image. Do NOT try to disable audio. Do NOT combine camera vocabulary with lighting/grade adjectives — pick one signal. Do NOT request extreme slow-motion.

declarative-long.description: Full positional description with individual character directions. Works: Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana Pro. Fails: all FLUX models.
declarative-long.template: Place N distinct Pixar characters in [setting]. Image 1 ([name], [age]): [position in frame], [action], [expression]. Image 2 ([name], [age]): [position], [action], [expression]. ... [Setting details]. Disney-Pixar aesthetic, rounded plastic-like forms, subsurface scattering on skin, bright saturated color palette, cinematic lighting. N distinct characters — all different people, never clone or merge them.

five-section.description: GPT Image 2 structured template: Scene / Subject / Important details / Use case / Constraints.
five-section.template: Scene: [setting description, framing]. Subject: [each character with position and action]. Important details: [style, lighting, proportions]. Use case: [context for the image]. Constraints: [character count, no duplicates, no text].

concise-at-syntax.description: Short prompt using @image1/@image2 syntax. ONE sentence max 50 words. Works: FLUX.2 Pro Edit. Fails if too long or too positional.
concise-at-syntax.template: @image1 [action] at [position], @image2 [action] at [position], @image3 [action] at [position], @image4 [action] at [position]. [Setting in 5-8 words]. [Style in 5-8 words]. [aspect ratio].

single-action-concise.description: Minimal single-sentence edit. Max 3 sentences, 30 words. Works: FLUX.2 Klein Edit. Use only for single-character edits.

omni-conversational.description: INVERSE of all other video model prompts. Terse 1-3 sentence natural-language brief that leans on Gemini's world knowledge. Works: Gemini Omni Flash (any endpoint). Fails on every other video model in this catalog. See .opencode/skills/fal-ai-community/fal-prompting/references/gemini-omni.md.
omni-conversational.template: [subject] [doing what] in [setting]. [One sentence about mood or intent]. [Optional plain-English camera note: 'one continuous shot' | 'slow push-in' | 'dolly zoom' | 'static' | 'locked off'].
omni-conversational.edit_variant: For google/gemini-omni-flash/edit: one short imperative sentence, ALWAYS append 'Keep everything else the same.' unless the intent is to redo the whole video. Max 20 words.

character_identity_rules.never_merge_identical_toddlers: Assign distinct outfit colors or accessories if multiple toddlers share similar features
character_identity_rules.prompt_anchor: Always label each character in prompt: 'Image 1 (NAME)', not 'the toddler'
